ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what will likely happen if the supply of carpenter ant decreases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. In the diagram, “Carpenter ant” is located in the lower, slightly middle position, and “Pileated woodpecker” is located above it. It can be seen that there is an arrow from Carpenter ant pointing to Pileated woodpecker, indicating that the pileated woodpecker feeds on carpenter ant or depends on it as a food source. Reasoning: The question asks what would happen if the supply of carpenter ant decreases. In a food web, when a certain food source decreases, consumers that depend on it will decrease in number because of reduced food. Therefore, the number of pileated woodpecker will very likely decrease.
